items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: That’s with Dion and the Belmonts. We were working this place and they were doing their show.

ctx.x: Yes. That’s with Dion and the Belmonts. We were working this place and they were doing their show. The bass player I was working with couldn’t read. So at that time I was good at reading bass clef so I took his Fender, I guess he had a Fender bass if I recall, and I played the bass part. That was the only time I played the bass. It was easy because the charts were very simple. It was playing on a one and three mostly or something like that, and I could read them off fast. And I played it with a pick on a bass…
Right. Did you ever do any extended road work?
